caption: ROUGE-1 metric for fine-tuning MBart and T5 models with adapters with different r with Gazeta dataset
model_annotation: The line plot, titled “Finetuning for different r, Gazeta,” illustrates the ROUGE-1 performance scores of four different fine-tuning configurations—T5 + LoRA, MBart + LoRA, T5 + AdaLoRA, and MBart + AdaLoRA—across varying values of the rank parameter r (logarithmically scaled) using the Gazeta dataset. The x-axis, labeled “log r,” spans from 0 to 9 with integer tick marks at each unit, indicating the logarithm of the adapter rank. The y-axis, labeled “ROUGE-1,” ranges from 0 to 35 with major gridlines every 5 units, representing the summarization quality metric. The red line with circular markers (T5 + LoRA) starts at approximately 23.5 when log r = 0 and remains relatively flat, peaking slightly around 24.5 at log r = 6 before gently declining to 24.2 at log r = 9. The purple line with circular markers (MBart + LoRA) begins at 5.0, dips to 2.5 at log r = 2, then rises sharply to 22.8 at log r = 4, and plateaus near 23.5 by log r = 8 before slightly decreasing to 23.2 at log r = 9. The green line with circular markers (T5 + AdaLoRA) starts at 23.5, steadily increases to 27.0 at log r = 4, and continues climbing more gradually to 30.2 at log r = 9. The orange line with circular markers (MBart + AdaLoRA) begins at 5.0, rises steeply to 19.5 at log r = 3, then continues increasing to 32.5 at log r = 6, and stabilizes around 33.2 from log r = 7 to 9. All lines use solid strokes and circular markers, with no error bars or shaded regions.
